title: This Little Piggy 🐷 | Tiny Tune Town Nursery Rhymes & Kids Songs
intro: This little piggy went to market! After bath time Daddy plays the toe game with Nomi on the sofa: one little piggy for each toe, all the way home, and a tickle on the nose. Then Nomi counts Daddy's big toes and big brother Kofi's toes, and the whole family wiggles and counts to five. A cosy, giggly sing-along of the classic nursery rhyme for babies, toddlers and preschoolers.
actions: Touch one toe for each little piggy
Run your fingers up for wee, wee, wee
Count to five: one, two, three, four, five
credit: Traditional public-domain nursery rhyme (Five Toes, The Real Mother Goose, 1916; This pig went to market, c. 1760). New verses and music by Tiny Tune Town.
